name: NonPlatonic Forms
storyline: Liam Lee’s solitary life as a freelance mechanic is turned upside down when he unwittingly catches the eye of Diegesis, storytelling incarnate… or so the creature claims. Figures from his past begin to emerge in strange and unfamiliar shapes. As the lines between reality and the fantastical begin to blur, they reveal a world he'll have to fight to remain alive in.
summary: A theologically spicy visual novel about a trans man loving the artistic process "a little too literally." Fight across a branching 250,000 word storyline, dozens of watercolor illustrations, and 9 endings.
